ArchivedSite.title: Archived Site
ArchivedSite.description: A website submitted by a user to the archive.

description.description: A brief description of the website.

userId.description: The ID of the user who submitted the site.

userName.description: The name of the user who submitted the site.

status.description: The status of the archive process.

Comment.description: A comment left by a user on an archived site.

userName.description: The name of the user who left the comment.

userPhoto.description: Optional photo URL of the user.

/comments/{commentId}.description: Collection of comments on archived websites.
